I looked and looked, but couldn't find a ruling about this. Sorry in
advance if I missed it.

If a minion equips with a Leather Jacket and manages to burn that
Jacket during the same minion phase in which he got it, will he untap
at the end of the turn? I would assume he does, but I'm not sure, since
the card that provides the untap is no longer in play.

John Eno

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


He does still untap at the end of the turn.
